design_hypothesis: A quiet, cool-toned mineral composition that reads restrained from a distance and richer at close range. The bracelet should rely on optical variation, asymmetric rhythm, a small structural silver intervention and one premium mineral focal zone rather than uniform bead repetition.

prototype_variants.description: Aquamarine round body + Rainbow Moonstone light rhythm + compact Larimar hero zone + curved silver structural interruption + round silver counterweight.
prototype_variants.purpose: Test the full Glacier Signature visual thesis.
structure_rules: Do not use a uniform same-size round-bead rhythm around the entire bracelet.
Keep one asymmetrical focal zone rather than a centered decorative pendant composition.
Use the curved silver tube as a structural interruption, not as a dominant luxury ornament.
Use Rainbow Moonstone as light/air, not as the only visual hero.
Aquamarine provides the main cool mineral body and visual continuity.
Larimar, if used, should be concentrated into a small hero zone rather than distributed evenly.
Maintain visible breathing space/rhythm changes through size, cut or hardware transitions instead of adding many material species.
Maximum core mineral species for P01: three. Maximum visible hardware languages: two.
